claims.quote: Parosphromenus bintan is a liquorice gourami from Indonesia, confirmed only from Bintan Island in the Riau Archipelago and from Bangka.

regions.name: Bintan Island
regions.quote: Type locality is Bintan Island, Riau Archipelago province, Indonesia, specifically 'just before km 45 on road from Tanjung Uban to Tanjung Pinang; 1°06'40.1"N, 104°30'09.8"E' and the only other confirmed localities are on the island of Bangka in Bangka-Belitung province.
